header.description: Activations of the 14336 neurons of layer 18's MLP of Llama-3.1-8B at the last token of every addition prompt a+b= (Feucht et al. 2026, arXiv:2605.01148, Section 5.2): the full activation silu(gate)*up that the down projection reads, and the gate half silu(gate) alone; workflows/scripts/arithmetic_neurons/figures.py averages the full activation by output sum for Figure 8a.
